r15-rename.title: Changing an entry's name
body: You said it's confusing to change an entry's name. Today you double-click the entry (or right-click → **Open details**) and type in the **What** box at the top; it saves when you press Enter or click away. Nothing on the entry hints at that, and nothing tells you it saved.
Two small fixes, shown below. Pick either, both or neither.
bullets: **Rename right on the entry:** a ✎ pencil appears when you point at an entry on Day or a card on the Desk, and **Rename** (F2) is first in the right-click menu. The name turns into a box; Enter saves, Esc cancels, and Undo is offered.
**Clearer in the details:** the "What" box becomes **Name**, with a pencil, and shows **✓ Saved** after a change.

questions.placeholder: e.g. double-click the name to rename instead of opening details

figures.caption: Where it is today, and why it's easy to miss.
Rename right on the entry: a pencil, and Rename in the menu.
The details: a Name box that says when it saved.
